package_info.why_malicious: The package is designed to steal Discord user tokens and browser information from multiple browsers and exfiltrate this data via a Discord webhook to an attacker-controlled channel. It masquerades as a legitimate module and executes malicious code upon installation.

malicious_snippets.code_behavior: Executes the main malicious payload (app.js) immediately after the package is installed.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: Running arbitrary code on postinstall is a common malware technique to ensure code execution as soon as the package is installed.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: Normal packages do not execute code with side effects on install, especially not code that accesses user data.
malice_analysis.similar_legitimate_use: Some legitimate packages use postinstall for setup or compilation, but not for data exfiltration.
key_indicators: no legitimate setup or build process

malicious_snippets.code_snippet: Accesses LevelDB files in browser and Discord directories to extract tokens and user data.
malicious_snippets.code_behavior: Scans specific directories for LevelDB files to extract Discord tokens and browser information.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: Accessing browser and Discord data directories to extract tokens is a clear sign of credential theft.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: Normal packages do not access or parse LevelDB files in browser or Discord directories.
malice_analysis.similar_legitimate_use: Forensics or backup tools may access these files, but not in a package claiming to be a Discord utility.

malicious_snippets.code_snippet: Fetches public IP address via https://api.ipify.org/?format=json
malicious_snippets.code_behavior: Obtains the victim's public IP address for exfiltration.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: Collecting the public IP address is a common step in profiling victims.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: Normal Discord-related packages do not need to know or exfiltrate the user's public IP.
malice_analysis.similar_legitimate_use: Some analytics or telemetry tools may collect IPs, but not in this context.

malicious_snippets.code_snippet: Sends collected data to a Discord webhook controlled by the attacker.
malicious_snippets.code_behavior: Exfiltrates stolen tokens, user info, and IP address to an external Discord webhook.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: Exfiltrating sensitive data to an external webhook is a hallmark of information-stealing malware.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: Legitimate packages do not send user tokens or browser data to third parties.
malice_analysis.similar_legitimate_use: Webhooks are used for notifications, but not for exfiltrating user credentials.

malicious_snippets.code_behavior: Executes a local binary (dropper.exe, bd.exe, or lib.exe) which may perform further malicious actions.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: Executing unknown binaries is a strong indicator of malware, especially when the binaries are not part of the package.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: Normal packages do not execute arbitrary binaries on the user's system.
malice_analysis.similar_legitimate_use: Some legitimate installers may run bundled binaries, but not in this context.
key_indicators: no legitimate reason for binary execution

attack_chain.action: Malicious package is installed, triggering postinstall script.
Main payload scans browser and Discord directories for LevelDB files to extract tokens and user data.

attack_chain.leads_to: Augments stolen data with IP information.

attack_chain.action: Exfiltrates all collected data to attacker's Discord webhook.
attack_chain.leads_to: Attacker receives stolen credentials and user info.

attack_chain.action: Other related packages execute suspicious binaries (dropper.exe, bd.exe, lib.exe) for further compromise.
attack_chain.leads_to: Potential further malware installation or system compromise.

behavioral_signatures: access to LevelDB files in browser and Discord directories
outbound HTTP requests to Discord webhook URLs
execution of unknown binaries via child_process.exec
file_indicators: references to LevelDB paths for Chrome, Brave, Opera, Yandex, Discord
presence of app.js, Grabber.js, Token.js, Webhook.js in package
network_indicators: outbound traffic to Discord webhook endpoints
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor for npm packages with postinstall scripts that execute arbitrary code. Flag packages that access LevelDB files in browser or Discord directories. Detect network requests to api.ipify.org and Discord webhook URLs from development environments. Alert on child_process.exec calls that attempt to run unknown binaries. Use file and process monitoring to identify suspicious access patterns and exfiltration attempts.
